governments.name: Loen Kingdom
governments.description: The largest and most influential kingdom of the Northern Continent.

governments.name: Intis Republic
governments.description: A powerful republic known for culture, politics and the influence of the Sun Church.

governments.name: Feysac Empire
governments.description: Military empire famous for discipline, conquest and devotion to the God of Combat.

governments.name: Feynapotter Kingdom
governments.description: Agricultural kingdom strongly connected to the Earth Mother faith.

governments.name: Lenburg
governments.description: Nation famous for education, scholarship and the White Tower Pathway.

governments.name: Masin Kingdom
governments.description: One of the smaller nations allied with neighboring northern countries.

governments.name: Segar
governments.description: Northern kingdom known through trade and regional politics.

governments.name: Rorsted Archipelago
governments.description: Island region heavily influenced by maritime powers and the Lord of Storms.

governments.name: Southern Continent
governments.description: Large continent divided among indigenous states and colonial territories.

governments.name: Forsaken Land of the Gods
governments.description: A cursed region isolated from the outside world and filled with ancient dangers.
